trail_poolhouse.body_zh: 沿这条林间小路向东南走约 75 m。馆内有室内泳池，从深水区池底潜下去，可以一路游进地下水族馆。
trail_poolhouse.body_en: Follow this forest path southeast for about 75 m. Dive through the floor of the deep end to swim all the way down into the underground aquarium.

poolhouse_entrance.body_zh: 室内泳池深 1.0–3.1 m。大厅西南角的楼梯通往地下 7 m 的水族馆。
poolhouse_entrance.body_en: Indoor pool, 1.0–3.1 m deep. The stairs in the southwest corner of the hall lead 7 m down to the aquarium.

pool_dive.body_zh: 深水区池底有一个方形洞口，下面接玻璃水管。按住 C 或 Ctrl 下潜，穿过水管就到了水族馆的下潜池，从东侧坡道上岸。
pool_dive.body_en: A square opening in the deep end leads into a glass tube. Hold C or Ctrl to dive, swim through the tube into the aquarium's dive basin, then walk out up the ramp on its east side.

stairs_aquarium.body_zh: 由此下楼 · 两跑楼梯，共 7 m

tank_north.body_zh: 24 米长、近 6 米深的海洋缸：礁石拱门、海带林、一艘沉没的独木舟。蝠鲼在上层滑翔，两条礁鲨在中层巡游，小丑鱼、蓝倒吊和成群的银鱼在珊瑚间穿梭。这个缸可以潜进去。
tank_north.body_en: A 24 m ocean tank, almost 6 m deep: a rock arch, a kelp forest and a sunken canoe. A manta ray glides near the top, two reef sharks patrol the middle, and clownfish, blue tangs and schools of silver fish weave through the corals. You can dive into this tank.

reef_dive.body_zh: 跳进下潜池，按住 C 下潜到池底，北侧有一条通道直通海洋大缸。鱼会躲开靠近的潜水员。原路游回就能上岸。
reef_dive.body_en: Jump into the dive basin and hold C to sink to the bottom. A passage on the north side leads straight into the ocean tank. The fish will swim away from divers who get too close. Swim back the same way to climb out.

tank_south.body_zh: 小丑鱼喜欢待在珊瑚附近；蓝倒吊和黄高鳍刺尾鱼都以藻类为食。
tank_south.body_en: Clownfish stay close to the corals; blue tangs and yellow tangs graze on algae.

tank_jelly.body_zh: 水母没有大脑，也几乎不会主动游泳，靠伞盖一张一缩随水漂动。蓝紫色的灯光让半透明的身体更清楚。
tank_jelly.body_en: Jellyfish have no brain and barely swim; they drift by pulsing their bell. The violet light shows off their translucent bodies.

canoe_dock.body_zh: 独木舟停在码头南侧。站在码头边看着它按 E 上船；W / S 划桨，A / D 转向，Shift 用力划；靠近码头或岸边按 E 下船。湖上有四个地方等你去发现，湖心还有一座小岛。
canoe_dock.body_en: The canoe is moored on the south side of the dock. Look at it from the dock edge and press E to board. W / S to paddle, A / D to turn, Shift to paddle harder, and E near the dock or a shore to step out. Four places on the lake are waiting to be found, including an islet in the middle.

lake_islet.body_zh: 只有划独木舟才能到这里。岛上有个小营地，晴朗的夜晚适合坐在营火边看星星。
lake_islet.body_en: You can only get here by canoe. There is a small camp on the islet; on a clear night, sit by the campfire and watch the stars.

snow_peak_trail.body_zh: 沿北岸往东，再顺着西侧山脊折返上山，约 200 m 到达雪山顶。林线以上没有树，27 m 以上终年积雪，山顶常年飘着小雪，能看见整片湖。
snow_peak_trail.body_en: Follow the north shore east, then switchback up the west ridge: about 200 m to the summit. Above the tree line there are no trees; above 27 m the snow never melts, light snow always drifts at the top, and you can see the whole lake.

snow_peak_summit.body_zh: 暮色湖畔的最高处。往西南看是整片湖、码头和木屋，东边和北边是地图尽头的群山。累了就在石堆旁的长椅上坐一会儿。
snow_peak_summit.body_en: The highest point of Dusk Lake. To the south-west lie the whole lake, the dock and the cabin; to the east and north the mountains at the edge of the map. Rest a while on the bench beside the cairn.

fairy_glade.body_zh: 白天这里只是一片安静的林间空地。到了晴朗的夜里（20:00 到凌晨 4:30），仙境会从地里长出来：发光的仙树、蘑菇圈、漂浮的小岛和小瀑布，还有成群的小仙子。林地尽头的月光石门通往别的世界——那些世界还在建造中。
fairy_glade.body_en: By day this is just a quiet clearing. On clear nights (20:00 to 4:30) a fairy glade grows out of the ground: a luminous tree, a ring of glowing mushrooms, floating islets with little waterfalls, and flocks of tiny fairies. The moonstone gate at the far end leads to other worlds, which are still being built.

cave_mouth.body_zh: 洞里有一尊会说话的老图腾，篝火常年不灭。图腾会托你去湖边各处做点小事。山洞最深处有一道发光的门，通往下一个世界。
cave_mouth.body_en: An old talking totem lives inside, beside a fire that never goes out. It will ask you to run small errands around the lake. At the very back of the cave a glowing gate leads to the next world.

stone_cottage.body_zh: 门锁着，屋里暂时进不去。窗台上落了一层灰，好像很久没人回来过。
stone_cottage.body_en: The door is locked, so you cannot go in yet. Dust lies on the windowsill, as if no one has been back for a long time.

west_falls.body_zh: 西边山坡上的泉水汇成一条小溪，在这里跌下两米多高的石坎，再穿过林子流进湖里。溪水很浅，可以踩着走过去；林道上有一座木板桥。
west_falls.body_en: Springs on the western slope gather into a creek that drops over a two-metre ledge here, then winds through the woods into the lake. The water is shallow enough to wade; the forest trail crosses it on a plank bridge.

north_gorge.body_zh: 观景小山被一道七米多深的裂缝劈开，林道从原木桥上跨过去。裂谷两头渐渐变浅，可以从东西两端走下谷底。
north_gorge.body_en: A crack more than seven metres deep splits the lookout hill, and the forest trail crosses it on a log bridge. The gorge grows shallow at both ends, so you can walk down to its floor from the east or the west.

dune_gate.body_zh: 石拱里的光门通往琥珀沙丘：落日下的沙海、月牙绿洲和一座阶梯神殿。看着光门按 E 进去，那边的光门能带你回来。
dune_gate.body_en: The light in this arch leads to the Amber Dunes: a sea of sand under the setting sun, a crescent oasis and a step temple. Look at the gate and press E to go through; the gate on the other side brings you back.

cs_welcome.body_zh: 五座浮岛漂在黄昏的云海上。绳桥连着西岛、北岛和东岛；北岛尽头的跳台通往最高的灯塔岛。岛上藏着 8 颗云珠，四座风灯等着被点亮。掉下云海也不要紧，风会把你托回岸上。
cs_welcome.body_en: Five islands float on a sea of sunset clouds. Rope bridges lead to the west, north and east isles, and stepping stones at the end of the north isle climb to the lighthouse, the highest of them all. Eight cloud pearls are hidden here and four wind beacons wait to be lit. If you fall into the clouds, the wind will carry you back.

cs_bridges.body_zh: 三座绳桥从主岛通往西岛的风车、北岛的石阵和东岛的观鲸台。桥身会微微下垂，两边有扶绳，放心走。
cs_bridges.body_en: Three rope bridges lead from the main island to the windmill on the west isle, the stone ring on the north isle and the whale watch on the east isle. The planks sag a little, and there are hand ropes on both sides.

cs_beacons.body_zh: 古树下、西岛、北岛和东岛各有一座风灯。看着灯按 E 点亮它。四座都亮起来的时候，绕着群岛游的天鲸会游过来。
cs_beacons.body_en: There is a wind beacon under the old tree and on the west, north and east isles. Look at one and press E to light it. When all four are lit, the sky whale circling the islands will swim in close.

cs_stones.body_zh: 十二块石头一块比一块高，通往灯塔岛。跑起来按空格跳过去。挑战模式下踩上第一块就开始计时。
cs_stones.body_en: Twelve stones, each a little higher than the last, lead to the lighthouse isle. Run and press Space to jump across. In Challenge mode a timer starts when you step on the first stone.

cs_whale.body_zh: 坐在长椅上，看天鲸在云海上慢慢绕圈。它从不落地，只在风灯亮起的时候游近一点。
cs_whale.body_en: Sit on the bench and watch the sky whale circle slowly over the clouds. It never lands, and only swims closer when the beacons are lit.

cs_lighthouse.body_zh: 群岛最高的地方。灯塔的光从不熄灭，给夜里迷路的云鸟指路。站在这里能看见所有的岛。
cs_lighthouse.body_en: The highest point of the islands. The lighthouse never goes dark, guiding cloud birds lost at night. From here you can see every island.

du_welcome.body_zh: 风把沙子吹成一道道沙脊。往北走是月牙绿洲，西边是石柱废墟和风蚀石拱，东边有驼队营地，最北的阶梯神殿上有一座空着的祭坛。沙子里埋着 6 块古代碎片。
du_welcome.body_en: The wind has shaped the sand into long ridges. North is the Crescent Oasis, west are the pillar ruins and the wind arch, east is a caravan camp, and on the step temple in the far north stands an empty altar. Six ancient shards lie buried in the sand.

du_oasis.body_zh: 沙海里唯一的一汪水，四周长着棕榈和青草。水最深两米多，可以下去游一游。
du_oasis.body_en: The only water in the sea of sand, ringed by palms and grass. It is over two metres deep at the middle, deep enough for a swim.

du_ruins.body_zh: 一圈石柱围着从前的广场，有的还顶着横梁，有的断成半截。那颗半埋在沙里的石像头，一直望着落日的方向。
du_ruins.body_en: A ring of pillars surrounds what was once a plaza. Some still carry their beams, others have broken in half. The stone head half buried in the sand has always faced the setting sun.

du_temple.body_zh: 四层石台，南面的台阶通到顶上的祭坛。祭坛上有六个空槽，把捡到的古代碎片带上去按 E 嵌回去。六块都放回去时，神殿会升起一道光。
du_temple.body_en: Four stone tiers, with stairs on the south side up to the altar at the top. The altar has six empty slots. Carry the ancient shards you find up there and press E to set them back in place. When all six are back, a beam of light rises from the temple.

du_arch.body_zh: 千百年的风把这块岩石掏空，只剩一道石拱。从下面走过去，抬头看看被夕阳照亮的拱顶。
du_arch.body_en: Centuries of wind hollowed this rock until only an arch remained. Walk underneath and look up at the arch lit by the setting sun.

du_camp.body_zh: 穿越沙海的驼队在这里歇脚：两顶帐篷、一堆篝火、几只木箱。驼队早就走了，篝火却一直烧着。
du_camp.body_en: Caravans crossing the sand rest here: two tents, a campfire and a few crates. The caravan left long ago, but the fire still burns.
